what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Iraq in Türkiye: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 49893 Iraqi asylum seekers in Türkiye, 51.5% of all asylum seekers from Iraq.
Refugees from Iraq, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in 1995 to 1996 and in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them.
From 2004 the government's opponents it records include the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam, IS and RJF.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1936 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 173245, at the end of 2019, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Türkiye.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Türkiye only.
